title: Add cursor resume to event subscriptions
description: Subscribers reconnect with ?since=<seq> and receive exactly the missed events.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Reconnect with a cursor replays missed events in order
2. No duplicates across reconnects
3. Property test covers interleaved writes

handoffs.content: Cursor is the global seq; keep filters server-side.

notes.content: SSE over WebSockets — one-directional is all we need.
